description: (0.5.0) The receipt verdict is reported separately from the body verdict, and a failing receipt is treated exactly as an absent one for every rule that consumes receipt-attested facts (RFC-ACDP-0010 §8 'Receipt failure does not invalidate the body'). Aligns RFC-ACDP-0010 §8 with the acdp-consumer manifest and fed-011.

input.body: The sig-001 golden context (valid signature and content_hash)
input.registry_receipt: The rcpt-001 receipt with ctx_id altered so that the §8 step 3 context binding fails

expected.behavior: Both verdicts are reported; the body is not presented as receipt-attested.

scenarios.name: B — signer key in verificationMethod only

expected.behavior: The RFC-ACDP-0010 §10 historical-key rule needs a verified receipt, so it does not apply and the overall result fails closed.

notes: Behavioral; not executed by scripts/conformance-runner.py. A federated resolver's wire behavior is unchanged (fed-009). (0.5.0) Stricter policy permitted: the MUST is to report the receipt verdict separately and treat a failing receipt as absent (RFC-ACDP-0010 §8). A consumer whose policy requires a verified receipt MAY instead fail closed with invalid_receipt (the rcpt-002 behaviour); 'success' is the outcome without such a policy. A stricter default is conformant.
